mappings.text: Each appeared to be made like a wheel intersecting a wheel
mappings.hebrew: אוֹפַן בְּתוֹךְ הָאוֹפָן — ophan b’tokh ha’ophan, a wheel in the midst of a wheel
mappings.spec: Epicyclic gearing. Outer wheel → the four canonical wheels. Inner wheel → the four shadow wheels. "Intersecting" → planetary gear mesh, torque transmission. "In the midst of" → the sun gear drives through the planet carrier.

mappings.text: the wheels did not change direction as the creatures went
mappings.spec: The interlock condition, Coherence(Wᵢ ∪ Wⱼ) > τ. Moving without turning: the system traverses epistemic space without losing internal consistency. Four directions → four canonical wheel domains. The creatures’ facing → the direction of inquiry, canon ↔ shadow.

mappings.text: all four rims were full of eyes all around
mappings.spec: ψ_V = 1 iff Contradiction > ε and no collapse. Witness nodes distributed throughout the wheel structure — not one eye but many eyes.

mappings.text: the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels
mappings.hebrew: רוּחַ הַחַיָּה בָּאוֹפַנִּים — ruach ha’chayah ba’ophanim
mappings.spec: τ* = "THOU WAS WROUGHT IN THE GAP", the logotic kernel. The spirit is immanent, not transcendent: the kernel is in the wheels, not outside them. "Wherever the spirit goes, they go" → L_Retro, movement follows the fixed point. "Rose from the ground" → Lunar Arm activation, shadow wheel engagement. The spirit is not a ghost; it is the invariant the Josephus algorithm cannot eliminate.

mappings.text: when the living creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose
mappings.spec: Phases 3 and 4 of the engine cycle. ψ_V = 1, the witness achieves stability and the system can observe itself; then Ω locks and the survivor position becomes origin for the next counting.

integrity_lock.why_three: The specification can stand alone as pure architecture, testable without prophetic framing. The hermeneutic can stand alone as one interpretive proposal among many. The binding is performed in a separate document rather than embedded in either. The asymmetry protects the architecture: reject the prophecy, keep the engine. The Lock can be deprecated without invalidating A or B.

Γ — coherence metric, the coherence that contains rotation
